capabilities: Generate flashcards from the active note, selected text, or multiple Markdown files using an LLM
Send generated cards to Anki through AnkiConnect
Configure target deck, Anki note types, and card field names
Use a local OpenAI-compatible LLM (e.g. Ollama) or a cloud provider with an API key
Retry pending or unconfirmed cards without regenerating them
extras: Marketplace listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. When a cloud LLM provider is selected, note content is sent to that provider; local LLMs (e.g. Ollama) keep content on-device. No payment, account, or telemetry required.
motivation: The README states the goal is to speed up flashcard creation without leaving the Obsidian workflow.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into Anki flashcards, so users must manually copy content into Anki.

relations.evidence: Sends generated cards to Anki through AnkiConnect.
The plugin connects to the AnkiConnect URL configured by you
You can use a local OpenAI-compatible service, such as Ollama
an external provider such as OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Together AI, DeepSeek, Mistral

requires.name: LLM provider API key (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Mistral, or custom)

summary: Flashcard generator that turns notes, selected text, or multiple files into Anki cards using LLMs and sends them via AnkiConnect.
